title: Teacher-forced sequence likelihood
goal:
Equation 1 factors $p(y_1, \ldots, y_{T'} \mid x_1, \ldots, x_T)$ into a product of per-step softmax probabilities, and Section 3.2 trains by maximizing its log. Write three functions. The target includes the final `<EOS>` token (Section 2).

- `decoder_inputs(target, eos)` returns the teacher-forced inputs: the `<EOS>` that ends the source, followed by the target without its last token. In Figure 1, the target `W X Y Z <EOS>` gets the inputs `<EOS> W X Y Z`.
- `sequence_log_prob(logits, target)` takes decoder logits of shape `(T', V)` and an integer target of length `T'`, and returns $\log p(y \mid x) = \sum_t \log p(y_t \mid v, y_1, \ldots, y_{t-1})$. It must stay finite for logits near 1000.
- `perplexity(total_log_prob, n_tokens)` returns the per-token perplexity $\exp(-\text{total} / n)$. Section 3.3 reports perplexity but doesn't define it; this is the usual definition.
hints: Subtract the row maximum before you exponentiate, then use `z - log(sum(exp(z)))`. The softmax runs over the vocabulary axis (the last one).
Pick the target's log probability from each row with `lp[np.arange(T), target]`.
The decoder input at step $t$ is the target token from step $t - 1$, so the inputs are the targets shifted right by one position.
